title: Workday and Events
summary: Work routines, events, evaluation, and coordination with others.
whyItMatters: Talking about schedules and events helps you coordinate tasks, explain changes, and evaluate how a workday or activity went.

mentalModel.title: Build a timeline
mentalModel.content: Place appointments, tasks, breaks, and events in chronological order.

mentalModel.title: Connect plan and result
mentalModel.content: State what was planned, what changed, and what consequence followed.

ruleBlocks.title: Describe recurring work
ruleBlocks.content: Use morgens, normalerweise, zuerst, danach, and zum Schluss with routine verbs.

ruleBlocks.title: Name event details
ruleBlocks.content: Include purpose, participants, place, start time, duration, and required preparation.

ruleBlocks.title: Evaluate concretely
ruleBlocks.content: Use gelungen, stressig, praktisch, pünktlich, or chaotisch and give a reason.

examples.de: Morgens beantworte ich zuerst meine E-Mails.
examples.en: In the morning I answer my emails first.

examples.de: Die Besprechung beginnt um zehn Uhr und dauert eine Stunde.
examples.en: The meeting starts at ten and lasts one hour.

examples.de: Der Workshop war gut organisiert, weil alle Informationen klar waren.
examples.en: The workshop was well organized because all the information was clear.

commonMistakes.correct: Use sequence words to make the order clear.

commonMistakes.reason: Stattfinden is the fixed verb for an event taking place.

comparisons.summary: Deshalb connects a situation to its consequence.
The communication lesson helps coordinate plans with other people.
